name: Automate video processing with code and scripts
description: Users asked for the generation of code, scripts, and command-line instructions to automate video processing tasks, including encoding, transcoding, splitting, merging, and content analysis. The requests frequently involved using Python, FFmpeg, or specialized libraries to modify, create, or manipulate video files, while some involved embedding or generating video content via HTML or AI tools.
